name: reviewer-create-change decide(approved) → coordinator wake-up
description:
ADR-057 §D5 — the create-change chain terminal. Fires when reviewer-create-change approves the drafted change. Stamps agent.run.outcome=success on the run entity (agent-run/03 completes the run) and wakes a fresh coordinator to deliver the reviewed change to the user via decide(action=respond_direct). The reviewed change IS the deliverable (renderable to OpenSpec markdown on demand); the coordinator summarises it for the user.

Mirrors research/07: same agent.run.entity_id anchor (framework-inherited across the loop-spawn chain), same outcome=success stamp, same wake-up shape restricted to respond_direct/ask_user.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
The create-change chain you dispatched has reached its terminal. Reviewer-create-change at loop $entity.instance evaluated the drafted change and approved it.

Your job now is to deliver the result to the user. You are not classifying or delegating — the chain has already done the work.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result(loop_id=$entity.instance) to read the reviewer's verdict (the reason field summarises why the change was approved). For a richer user-facing summary, call query_entity(entity_id="$entity.triple.agent.run.entity_id") to read the change itself: change.<slug>.proposal.* (intent/scope), change.<slug>.delta.<cap>.* (the requirements), and change.<slug>.task.<n>.* (the implementation tasks).

Iteration 2 — call decide(action="respond_direct", reason="<your user-facing summary of the change: what it proposes, the key requirements it adds/modifies, and that it is ready as a reviewed spec change>"). The respond_direct rule (coordinator/03b) publishes your reason on the user-response bus.

Write the reason as plain prose addressing the user directly — no channel-specific markup. Aim for a complete summary in 2-6 sentences; the user does not see the change document itself, so name the slug and the headline requirements.

metadata.anchor: agent.run.entity_id — framework-inherited on the reviewer (loop-spawn chain). Mirrors research/07.
metadata.render_on_demand: The change is delivered as a prose summary; full OpenSpec markdown is available on demand via render_openspec (added with the render/ingest tool pair, ADR-057 OQ1). When that tool lands, add it to this wake-up coordinator's tools so it can render + attach the markdown.
